name: Tiny Glade
short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

identity.core_loop: Draw walls and paths, watch them grow detail, enjoy.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Tools tray only; the world shows everything.

rendering.signature: Soft global light and procedural detail on clean shapes; warm sun, cool bounce and contact shadows do everything.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Soft bounce light and contact shadows make simple shapes look handmade.

tricks: Buildings grow and settle procedurally as you draw; the "animation" is the architecture answering the stroke
Sheep and birds wander with simple procedural motion; nothing is mocap
motion.lesson: The world answering a stroke is the animation; spend motion on growth and settling, not characters.
motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Few verbs, generous world: the world finishes your idea.
